lines.text: Before every walk on Mars, an astronaut needs three answers: can I get there, can I get back, and will anyone hear me?
MarsView turns real NASA and ESA data, one-meter HiRISE terrain, MEDA weather and Perseverance's own route, into a go or no-go.
When the answer is no, it says why, and what to change: carry less, or turn back at three kilometers.
Out there, ARES follows the walk and calls the turn-back point.
MarsView. Every step planned. Every breath counted.
